Did you experience any visual changes, such as "tunnel vision" or graying out, in the few seconds before you fell? Also, have you had any similar episodes in the past?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Vasovagal Syncope (Micturition Syncope).

The ECG and Echocardiogram are normal, and the loss of consciousness occurred immediately after urination with rapid recovery and no prodrome of palpitations. These findings rule out cardiac causes and seizures, confirming the diagnosis of micturition syncope, a specific subtype of vasovagal syncope.
